title: CHU de Bordeaux says its information system was compromised; Scarlettgroup ransomware group claims the attack on its leak site
summary: According to ZATAZ, the CHU de Bordeaux said on 24 November that its investigations established a compromise of its information system, after two hospital email addresses were used to mass-send emails on 23 November. Scarlettgroup listed the hospital on its leak site on 22 November and claims patient and administrative data. The hospital says care continues normally and that it is still determining whether data was extracted.
plain: Bordeaux university hospital says its IT system was compromised. A ransomware group claims it stole data; the hospital has not confirmed any data was taken, and care continues normally.
exec: The hospital confirms a compromise of its information system, per ZATAZ; whether data was extracted is not yet established, and Scarlettgroup's data claims are unverified.
action: The hospital says it will contact individually any people identified as affected, per Generation NT; no other advice is given. General advice: be wary of unexpected emails purporting to come from the hospital.

validation.note: ZATAZ and generation-nt (independent publishers) both relay the hospital statement that its information system was compromised; neither confirms data theft. Hospital's own notice not read. Cyberattaque.org reports the leak-site claim.

review.note: Compared title, dates (22 Nov listing, 23 Nov emails, 24 Nov confirmation), no-data-confirmed wording, action against ZATAZ, generation-nt, Cyberattaque.org
